official_sources.title: Qatar Visa Center (biometrics, medical and contract signing in some sending countries)

notes: Qatar has a minimum basic wage, plus allowances for food and housing when the employer does not provide them. Confirm the current figures on the Ministry of Labour site.
Employers may not keep a worker's passport.

visa_routes.name: Work residence permit
visa_routes.summary: The employer sponsors the work visa. In sending countries with a Qatar Visa Center, biometrics, the medical exam and contract signing happen there before travel.

steps.title: Job offer through a licensed recruiter
steps.description: Get a written offer and check the recruiter's licence in your home country.

steps.title: Employer applies for the work visa
steps.description: The Qatari employer applies; the visa profession should match the job you were promised.

steps.title: Visa center appointment
steps.description: Complete biometrics, the medical exam and the electronic contract signing at the Qatar Visa Center. Read the contract on screen before you sign.

steps.title: Departure formalities at home
steps.description: Complete your home country's emigration registration, insurance and briefing.

steps.title: Residence permit after arrival
steps.description: The employer completes your residence permit. Keep your own passport.

documents: Educational or trade certificates if required

requirements.title: Biometrics, medical and contract signing
requirements.description: Done at the Qatar Visa Center where one operates in your country.
